With $F^+F^-=I/M$, as for the [Discrete Fourier transform](dft.md), it follows that $MF^+\bigl((F^-f)(F^-g)/r\bigr)=\frac{f*g}{rM}$.

Since $LB$ permutes records and leaves polynomial suffixes intact, $P(LBu,LBv)=LBP(u,v)$. So the opposite transform $\mathcal T_+$ applied to the pointwise product of the stored forward outputs equals $F^+P(F^-f,F^-g)$
Here $\delta$ bounds each forward error and $\eta$ the truncation error, with $\delta=\sqrt2\ell\,2^{-p}$ and $\eta=\sqrt2\,2^{-p}$ as above.

By bilinearity, $P(\widetilde u,\widetilde v)-P(u,v)=P(\widetilde u-u,\widetilde v)+P(u,\widetilde v-v)$. Each term is less than $\delta$, using the contraction bound for $P$ and norm at most $1$ of $\widetilde v$ and $u$, so $\|P(\widetilde u,\widetilde v)-P(u,v)\|_\infty<2\delta$.
With $\widetilde z=Q_p(P(\widetilde u,\widetilde v))$ and $z_*=P(u,v)$, truncation gives $\|\widetilde z-z_*\|_\infty<2\delta+\eta$.

and $\|\mathcal T_+(\widetilde z-z_*)\|_\infty\le\|\widetilde z-z_*\|_\infty$ since $\mathcal T_+$ is a contraction. The triangle inequality gives $\|\widetilde h-\mathcal T_+z_*\|_\infty<3\delta+\eta$.
The exact multiplication by $M$ gives total error less than $M(3\delta+\eta)=\sqrt2\,M(3\ell+1)2^{-p}$

There are $M=T/r$ products, so they cost $O(Tp\log(rp))$ in total. Each transform and the final linear scaling cost $O(Tp[dK+pK^{\tau-1}+\ell d^{\lambda'}])$, with $\tau,\lambda'$ the exponents of the layout page.

relations.quote: The transforms are laid out as in [Tape layout for synthetic transforms](transform-layout.md).
Each record product is formed by [Signed packing](signed-packing.md) in $O(rp\log(rp))$ time, then truncated by $Q_p$, which changes it by less than $\eta=\sqrt2\,2^{-p}$ without raising the norm.

So the opposite transform $\mathcal T_+$ applied to the pointwise product of the stored forward outputs equals $F^+P(F^-f,F^-g)$, and no reordering is needed, as in [Retained frequency order](frequency-order.md).
